| "The UK's number one tea subscription" | Unsupported. Superlative/ranking; policy bans "number one" and "the UK's favourite". |
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | Allowlisted (subscription terms). |
| "Free UK delivery on orders over £25" | Allowlisted (shipping policy). |
| "Tea Subscription UK" (headline) | Descriptive, not a claim. Fine. |

**Other checks**
- Slop/banned words: none.
- Disclosure: this is our own paid social/search ad; no extra label required.
- Landing page: the ad's remaining claims (pause/cancel, free delivery) need to appear on the landing page too. Worth confirming.
- Platform policy: nothing health, finance or personal-attribute related.
- Character limits: none were given, so I haven't counted. Note that a headline of "Tea Subscription UK" is short and could use more of the available space.

**Problem:** "The UK's number one tea subscription" can't be backed up and must come out.

**Compliant version**

Headline: Organic Tea Subscription | Pebblebrook
Description: Certified organic by the Soil Association. Pause or cancel any time. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

(If you want to keep the original headline, "Tea Subscription UK" works as is. Only the description needs changing. Check both against any character limits before use.)
